triggers.filterCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var caster = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!caster) return false; if (!ctx.sourcePiece || ctx.sourcePiece.instanceId !== caster.instanceId) return false; if (ctx.targetPiece && caster.instanceId === ctx.targetPiece.instanceId) return false; return !!(caster.statusTags && caster.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.id === 'holy-charge-buff'; })); }
triggers.effectCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var caster = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!caster) return { success: false }; var buff = caster.statusTags && caster.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.id === 'holy-charge-buff'; }); if (!buff) return { success: false }; if (ctx.damage === undefined || ctx.damage <= 0) return { success: false }; ctx.damage += buff.intensity || 2; buff.remainingUses = (buff.remainingUses || 1) - 1; if (buff.remainingUses <= 0) { removeStatusEffectById(caster.instanceId, 'holy-charge-buff'); self.expire(); } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '的圣光充能触发，伤害+' + (buff.intensity || 2) }; }
